title: Act: Implement stale lock release and Startup
summary: Add LockFS, ReleaseStaleLock and Startup to the recovery package.
description: Create backend/worker/internal/recovery/locks.go with the LockFS abstraction, an os implementation, ReleaseStaleLock and Startup, which releases a stale lock then runs Recover. Uses Recoverer fields from recovery.go.
acceptance_criteria: A lock older than StaleAfter is removed
Startup runs Recover only after the lock check succeeds
technical_constraints: Recoverer and Result come from recovery.go in the same package

steps.action: Define interface LockFS {ModTime(path string) (time.Time, error); Remove(path string) error} and struct OSLockFS implementing it with os.Stat(path).ModTime() and os.Remove(path).
steps.code: func (OSLockFS) ModTime(p string) (time.Time, error) { fi, err := os.Stat(p); if err != nil { return time.Time{}, err }; return fi.ModTime(), nil }

steps.action: Implement ReleaseStaleLock() (bool, error): call lockFS.ModTime(cfg.LockPath); if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) return false,nil; other errors wrapped as "recovery: stat lock: %w"; if now().Sub(mod) <= cfg.StaleAfter return false,nil; otherwise call lockFS.Remove, wrapping errors as "recovery: remove lock: %w" and ignoring fs.ErrNotExist, and return true,nil. Add a comment that StaleAfter must exceed Timeout times (MaxRetries+1).
steps.expected: Returns true only when a stale lock was removed.

steps.action: Implement Startup(ctx) (Result, error): call ReleaseStaleLock; on error return Result{} and the error; then call Recover and set Result.LockReleased to the released value before returning.
steps.expected: Stale lock is released before any execution is resumed.
